spec_acs.text: `Catalog.add` appends exactly one `(source, line, uid)` tuple per call to `catalog.metadata[msg]`, and repeated calls for the same message preserve all occurrences in order.
`Catalog.add` ignores an origin object that has no `uid` attribute, leaving `catalog.metadata` unchanged and raising no exception.
`Catalog.add` stores `''` when `origin.source` is falsy and `-1` when `origin.line` is `None`, while preserving non-empty source strings and non-`None` line numbers.

`GettextRenderer(template_path, outdir)` exposes its loader search paths as the supplied user paths first, in the supplied order, followed by `DEFAULT_TEMPLATE_PATH`; with `template_path=None` the default path is present and the default `message.pot.jinja` template can be loaded.
`GettextRenderer` stores `outdir` unchanged and installs the same callable under both `env.filters['e']` and `env.filters['escape']`.

The installed gettext escape filter turns backslashes into doubled backslashes, double quotes into backslash-quote, and newlines into the gettext continuation form without re-escaping the escape characters it inserts.

`GettextRenderer.render(filename, context)` adds a `relpath` callable to the supplied context whose result equals `canon_path(relpath(source, outdir))` and returns the rendered template text for that context.
`BaseRenderer.render(template, context)` loads the named template from its environment and returns the rendered text, so `GettextRenderer.render` can delegate to it successfully.
A rendered `message.pot.jinja` includes source locations using `relpath` with forward slashes and contains `msgid`/`msgstr` text escaped by the gettext filter.
The implementation introduces no syntax/import errors and no unrelated source files are modified.

`Metadata.from_raw({"metadata_version": "2.5", "name": "packaging", "version": "2023.0.0"})` exposes a `Version`, validates successfully, and does not mutate the input dict.

`Metadata.from_raw` collects errors for missing required fields, invalid values, malformed content-type parameters, and fields newer than the declared metadata version into one `ExceptionGroup("invalid metadata", ...)`, never leaking IndexError.
